baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to follow is qualified by both the negated request for compensation and the predicate that its objects are guided.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following transfers practical orientation from a leader to followers. Negated solicitation removes a direct incentive conflict, while the guided predicate supplies positive route competence.

activation_trace.role: Trailing and imitation supply movement behind a prior leader.
Request and solicitation name the act explicitly negated.
Wage or return for work names the transfer the guides do not demand.
Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies positive directional competence.

changed_reading.before: Follow these people simply because the imperative says so.
changed_reading.after: Followability is argued from a two-part test: they demand no payment and are themselves oriented toward the right route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins stepwise following to the guided ones' direction, conduct, and intent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tracking branch of following and the conduct branch of guidance turn the command from assent into reproducible practice. The absent fee makes the relation closer to apprenticeship than purchased advice.

activation_trace.role: Tracing one mark after another makes following a stepwise reconstruction.
Direction, manner, and intent make the guides' conduct itself a course.
The negated request blocks a client-provider relation.
Compensation supplies the commercial term excluded from the relationship.

changed_reading.before: Accept the content of what they say.
changed_reading.after: Track and reproduce their ordered manner of proceeding; the verse commends a lived course, not only a proposition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The refusal of compensation stands beside a form of h d y whose inventory also includes a gift sent in affection.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gift branch cross-activates with the explicit refusal of a wage: direction can be received as benefaction and continued relationally rather than bought as a commodity.

activation_trace.role: A gently sent gift supplies a noncommercial mode for transmitting guidance.
Wage supplies the exchange relation that the verse negates.
Negated asking keeps the offered direction from becoming a demanded exchange.
Following is the recipient's practical uptake of the offered direction.

changed_reading.before: The guides merely waive a fee.
changed_reading.after: Their leading can be carried as gifted direction: a benefaction received and enacted rather than a service purchased.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative uses t b a, whose inventory includes both following and a consequence or claim that follows and adheres.
baseline_models.mechanism: The attached-liability branch prevents the absence of a wage from meaning absence of stakes. Entering a course may bring obligations and consequences after it even when no upfront charge is collected.

activation_trace.role: A consequence or claim that follows a person supplies the path's attached liability.
Direction and conduct identify the course to which consequences may attach.
The negated wage distinguishes attached consequence from an immediate fee.

changed_reading.before: Because the guidance is free, following it is costless.
changed_reading.after: No payment is demanded, yet entering the guided course can attach obligations and consequences to the follower.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pairing gives a noble reward to the one who follows, whereas the focus denies that the guides request reward from the audience. Compensation is not erased; its direction and source are reversed.

activation_trace.role: The focus wage is the compensation not collected from hearers.
The focus imperative places the hearers behind the guides.
The earlier follower supplies the receiving side of the reversed economy.
The noble recompense supplies a reward promised to the follower rather than demanded by the guide.

structural_cues: 36:11 and 36:21 repeat both following and reward but assign reward to opposite sides of the relation.
The earlier occurrence precedes the town narrative and therefore frames its economic test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root pair and the opposite grammatical directions; I infer that compensation is relocated from audience-to-guide to a nonhuman source-to-follower. A live alternative is that the two rewards are unrelated uses.

changed_reading.before: Lack of a fee is only evidence that the guides are sincere.
changed_reading.after: The guides refuse to monetize guidance while following opens onto recompense for the follower; the verse reverses who pays and who receives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet first records what people send ahead and the marks they leave. The focus command then becomes trace selection: follow the course whose remaining marks are worth reproducing and having entered into the record.

activation_trace.role: Stepwise tracking anchors the focus as movement by traces.
Direction and manner distinguish the course whose traces are copied.
Inscription that establishes a judgment makes traces durable and accountable.
Advancing forward supplies the deeds sent ahead of the traveler.
A remaining sign of what passed supplies the persistent footprint that others can follow.

structural_cues: The record of advances and traces at 36:12 stands shortly before the repeated following commands at 36:20-21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recorded advances, remaining traces, and the focus's tracking branch; I infer that choosing guides also chooses a reproducible trace. The live alternative is that 36:12 concerns all deeds without privileging guided footsteps.

changed_reading.after: Choose and reproduce their trail, because following creates enduring traces that enter an accountable record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messengers restrict what rests upon them to making the message reach and become clear. Their refusal of compensation is therefore a mission boundary: they deliver without turning hearers into paying clients or claiming control over uptake.

activation_trace.role: Negated solicitation removes a claim against the audience.
The excluded wage prevents delivery from becoming a client contract.
Causing a message to reach its addressee defines the messengers' positive task.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign defines the quality of that delivery.

structural_cues: The restrictive construction at 36:17 precedes the no-reward criterion at 36:21 within one exchange.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a restricted duty of clear conveyance and a later refusal of wages; I infer a boundary between delivery and ownership of hearers. Alternatively, the restriction may state only a minimum duty rather than exclude every reciprocal relation.

changed_reading.before: The guides happen not to charge.
changed_reading.after: Nonpayment belongs to their office: their obligation is clear delivery, not acquisition of clients, revenue, or control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the speaker crosses the city's farthest distance in purposeful motion and then repeats the imperative to follow. His body performs committed movement before his words ask it of others.

activation_trace.role: Stepwise pursuit anchors the imperative as enacted movement.
The farthest side supplies a real distance traversed before the appeal.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end makes the speaker's arrival a performed commitment.
The first imperative explicitly identifies the messengers as those behind whom the town should move.

structural_cues: 36:20 ends with the first imperative and 36:21 immediately repeats it with criteria.
Motion from the farthest part of the city precedes both imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distance, purposeful motion, and the repeated command; I infer that the speaker models the demanded following. The distance may alternatively be narrative staging without exemplary force.

changed_reading.before: Following is an inward assent requested by a speaker.
changed_reading.after: Following is visible, purposeful movement toward and behind the messengers, already embodied by the person issuing the appeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speech moves immediately from following people to serving the Originator and returning to Him; the speaker's own route then reaches entry, protection from fault, and honor. Later, service to God is itself named the straight path. Guided people function as proximate route markers, not terminal owners of allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Following supplies the human mediation that needs an endpoint beyond the guides.
Direction, purpose, and course make the guides valuable through where their way leads.
Return supplies the ultimate destination announced immediately after the focus.
Entry into an interior supplies the speaker's reached destination.
The tree-screened garden gives concrete form to the reached destination.
Covering fault and protecting from its effect supplies one outcome of the traveled course.
Granted honor supplies another outcome rather than a fee paid to the human guides.
Humble service identifies the allegiance at the route's endpoint.
The straight road explicitly converts allegiance into a path image.
Straightness, balance, and uprightness qualify that road.

structural_cues: 36:22 immediately redirects the speech from following messengers to the Originator and return.
36:26-27 narrate the speaker's destination, while 36:61 later names service to God as the straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the local redirection, the speaker's outcome, and the later straight-path equation; I infer that the human guides mediate rather than possess allegiance. A live alternative is that the outcome validates only the speaker's faith, not the focus's criterion for guides.

changed_reading.before: Transfer allegiance from the town's leaders to these admirable people.
changed_reading.after: Follow these people as route markers whose course returns to the Originator; their refusal of payment helps keep them from becoming terminal masters.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun flows toward a station by measured ordering, and all bodies swim in their courses without collision. These motions activate guidance as direction and following as ordered succession: right guidance is disciplined course alignment, not static possession.

activation_trace.role: Ordered succession supplies the human analogue of coordinated motion.
Direction, aim, and manner anchor the focus in course alignment.
Continuous flowing motion supplies a course rather than a static location.
Deliberate measured ordering supplies the constraint governing that motion.
The celestial course supplies a stable channel for plural movement.
Swimming or running supplies active motion maintained within the course.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 form a motion sequence of flow, measure, non-overtaking, course, and swimming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a measured cosmic choreography and the focus supplies direction plus succession; I infer a cross-domain analogy between cosmic and ethical course alignment. The live alternative is that the cosmic signs carry no direct social analogy.

changed_reading.after: The guides are recognizably in course: their direction and sequence align movement within measured limits, and following enters that order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The guides do not draw compensation toward themselves, but the hearers are later told to move allotted provision outward by feeding others. The focus is not anti-material; it distinguishes private extraction from responsible circulation.

activation_trace.role: Negated asking blocks an inward demand by the guides.
The wage specifies the private transfer not requested.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the required outward material flow.
Allotted giving frames resources as prior provision rather than the hearer's absolute possession.
Feeding another supplies the social destination of the outward flow.

structural_cues: The focus negates a transfer to guides, while 36:47 commands a transfer from provision toward those needing food.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite material directions; I infer an ethic of nonextractive circulation rather than a blanket rejection of economic obligation. Alternatively, the two passages may address independent tests of sincerity and generosity.

changed_reading.before: A trustworthy guide never implicates the audience's resources.
changed_reading.after: A trustworthy guide refuses private compensation yet can call followers to send received provision outward for others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later recompense answers intended work, and bodily members become witnesses to what was acquired. The human wage rejected in the focus is replaced by deed-linked adjudication: the path is free of a collector but not free of consequences.

activation_trace.role: An adhering consequence supplies the liability that can follow one's chosen course.
The refused wage supplies the immediate human settlement displaced by later adjudication.
Answering an act with its consequence supplies the later settlement.
Purposeful action supplies what the recompense answers.
A witnessing sign makes embodied conduct evidence of the chosen course.
Acquiring gain supplies the deeds to which the bodily evidence testifies.

structural_cues: 36:54 ties recompense exclusively to action; 36:65 makes the body testify to acquisition.
These later settlements contrast with the guides' refusal to collect a wage at 36:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refused human payment, action-based recompense, and embodied evidence; I infer a jurisdictional shift from guide-collected fee to consequence attached to deeds. The alternative is that wage and final recompense are separate economies with no intended contrast.

changed_reading.after: The guides collect nothing, but following remains consequential: one's enacted course supplies its own evidence and receives its fitting answer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the secondary s l l mapping at the focus's asking token, so it is not a translation of the clause. It remains anchored in the supplied split inventory and is sharpened by the later outward-flow economy; downstream prose should call it a counterimage of covert extraction, not a lexical sense of the surface verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated s a l token maps not only to asking but also to s l l branches of gentle or hidden withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Gentle and hidden drawing-out supplies a covert extraction image under the negation.
Compensation identifies the value that must not be quietly drawn toward the guides.
Open expenditure supplies the contrasting legitimate movement of resources outward.
Allotted provision supplies what should circulate rather than be covertly extracted.

changed_reading.before: The guides do not openly invoice the audience.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory counterimage, they also do not draw value out quietly; legitimate material flow moves provision outward rather than secretly toward leaders.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the secondary h d d threat branch at the focus's h d y token, so 'not threatening' must not replace 'guided' in translation. It remains worth carrying because the packet puts explicit threatened stoning and pain immediately before the focus; render it only as a contrastive undertone distinguishing guidance from coercion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus predicate h d y has a supplied secondary h d d inventory that includes threat and intimidation.

activation_trace.role: Threat and intimidation supply a counterimage against which guided leadership is heard.
Refused compensation pairs nonextraction with the noncoercive counterimage.
Injurious speech figured as stone-throwing supplies the opposing town's coercive voice.
An effect that reaches and strikes its object makes the threat bodily consequential.
Pain supplies the threatened outcome used to force silence.

changed_reading.after: As a contained undertone, follow the nonextractive leaders whose authority is guidance rather than the opposing voice's threat of pain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-activates the focus wage with the same root's technical branch for setting a broken bone. It remains anchored by the explicit a j r inventory and by the surah's decayed-bone and re-creation sequence; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, never as the clause's direct lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun a j r names compensation but its supplied inventory also carries mending a fracture, especially one healed with residual crookedness.

activation_trace.role: Setting a fracture supplies a repair image beneath the explicitly refused wage.
Gentle direction keeps the repair image attached to the guides' role.
Decay and crumbling supply the broken material whose restoration is disputed.
Bringing a thing into being supplies restoration at the Creator's level rather than by a guide's fee.

changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, they levy no repair charge for a broken mortal condition; ultimate restoration belongs to the One who first brings creation into being.

strongest_changes: The repeated following-reward pair relocates compensation from a fee paid to guides to recompense received by followers.
Following becomes selection and reproduction of an embodied, recorded course whose consequences remain attached to deeds.
Human guides become nonowning route markers toward the Originator, while material obligation is redirected outward toward recipients in need.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted a simple sincerity test into a directional economy: messages reach without client ownership, provision circulates without leader extraction, bodies and celestial signs move in courses, and consequences answer the traces people choose to leave.
remaining_uncertainties: The guidance-as-gift activation is coherent with the no-wage construction but remains semantically more distant than the path branches.
The measured celestial course may be an illuminating analogy rather than a direct mechanism for the social imperative.
The s l l, h d d, and fracture-repair readings depend on supplied secondary branches and must remain explicitly exploratory counterimages.
